description: A reply-style post whose text is prefixed with @mentions, as real threaded posts are. The coordinate is parsed and the detection is referenceless (source null). The derivation keeps the leading @mentions verbatim in the title and proof; it strips coordinates, hashtags, urls and list markers, not mentions.

bot.diverges: The bot's grammar reads a coordinate only from a line that is nothing but the decimal pair; here the pair sits inside the prose, so the mention is refused where the shared resolution reads the coordinate.
